# Cycle19 sealed handoff

The pinned release has **372 catalogue families and 722 manuscript directories/PDF paths**. IDs reach 377 because 045, 061, 070, 123, and 163 are omitted. There are 751 preprint PDF files in total, 235 numbered Lean scope documents, and 405 Comparator configurations. These are distinct inventory objects; they are not counts of verified theorems.

The complete frozen source-path inventory and selective retrieval helper are ready. The original recursive API trees were truncated, and a later API call hit HTTP403. A Git `blob:none` metadata fetch recovered every path, with zero blob bodies in the Git metadata checkout. Every selected raw file is checked against its pinned Git blob hash and given a SHA256 receipt. No release script, install, Lean build, or Comparator run was executed.

The formalization manifest explicitly says partial progress and unchecked review. All 405 tiny configurations were parsed and hash-verified. All permit the same three standard axioms; nine list definition holes requiring mathematical-meaning review in addition to checking a proof. The release Lake configuration itself performs dependency-cloning/patching IO. Successful verification remains conditional on a clean, trusted configuration/import boundary and actual export/kernel replay; none occurred here.

The substantive source audit is family 240's CH prescribed-threshold companion. Its selected challenge and submitted theorem types and model definitions match modulo comments/whitespace. All 15 custom imports were scanned with no proof holes or new axiom tokens; Mathlib remains the external unreviewed boundary. I independently reconstructed the universal countable-matrix normalization mechanism and checked 28 finite transcriptions with a rejected boundary mutation. This does not certify the rest of the AEC/partition proof, the separate qualitative eventual-categoricity paper, or the relative-consistency corollary.

Root additionally requested current coverage navigation. The aggregator snapshots explicit worker assessments, preserves their literal read depths/statuses and uncertainty, and reports missing assessments as unknown. It retains omitted IDs and duplicate assessments without inflating the 372 denominator. It makes no automatic scientific ranking or proof-adoption decision.
